create_StreamDataset: create a StreamDataset to prepare tokenized batches with fixed bptt for streaming iteration
create_Dataset: create a Dataset to batch sentences by fixed count or tokens-per-batch with optional size grouping
create_ParallelDataset: create a ParallelDataset to batch paired sentence pairs with synchronized length-based grouping
build_batch_sentences: build batches from a list of sentences padded to equal length with eos markers
test_get_iterator: test the get_iterator method to yield shuffled or ordered sentence batches with configurable subsampling
